preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each vertex from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(dominant_index(i + 1, adj)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th line of output (0-indexed) is the string representation of the dominant index of vertex i+1.

postconditions.expression: all(is_dominant_index(v, adj, int(output_lines[v-1])) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every vertex v, the output value satisfies the definition of a dominant index: it is strictly greater than all counts at smaller distances and greater than or equal to all counts at larger distances.
